review_text: My two-person tent leaked during light rain on its first night.
The fuel valve sticks open and gas keeps escaping after I turn it off. I stopped using it.
Warm, comfortable, and no blisters after a long walk. No complaints.
Comfortable straps and plenty of room for lunch and a rain jacket.
The left sole is peeling after two short walks on dry paths.
Keeps light rain out, but feels stuffy when walking uphill.
The battery compartment overheated and melted the plastic. It burned my finger.
The cap leaks whenever I put the bottle on its side in my bag.
Wonderful surprise: the zipper broke on the first use. Just what I needed.
Still deciding. They feel different from my old pair, but nothing is broken.
